We are known for our holistic, relationship-based, and play-centered therapy approach, following developmental models like DIR/FLOORTIME. Our mission is to empower children and families while nurturing growth, connection, and emotional well-being.

• Clinical Child Psychologists.
• Licensed Psychotherapists (able to work in Germany).
• Occupational Therapists.
• Speech and Language Therapists.

• FAMILY SUPPORT: Engage, coach, and collaborate with parents and caregivers as part of each child's therapeutic journey.

• Licensed as a CLINICAL PSYCHOLOGIST or PSYCHOLOGICAL PSYCHOTHERAPIST with eligibility to practice in Germany (e.g., approbation or equivalent).
• Experience working with young children and families, ideally with ages 2 to 15.
• Familiarity with developmental models such as DIR/Floortime, play therapy, or other child-centered approaches (or willingness to learn).
• English fluency (our client base is international).
• Strong interpersonal skills, flexibility, and genuine passion for child development and family-centered work.

WHAT WE OFFER:

• FULL-TIME POSITION: 40 hours per week, with a balance between clinical work (28 hours) and time for documentation, supervision, and team meetings (12 hours).
• ONGOING SUPERVISION: Weekly individual and group supervision sessions plus staff meetings for professional growth and peer support.
• PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: Opportunities for continued training and workshops.
• MULTIDISCIPLINARY ENVIRONMENT: Work alongside a diverse and supportive team of psychologists, occupational therapists, and speech-language therapists.
• MEANINGFUL WORK: Directly impact the lives of children and families in a nurturing, play-based setting.

About usMenlo Systems is a high-tech company that develops, manufactures and sells lasers and laser systems for precision applications in research and industry. Menlo Systems is one of the market leaders in the field of optical precision measurements with light and lasers based on the Nobel Prize-winning frequency comb technology. The company is headquartered in Martinsried, near Munich, Germany.

ABOUT THE ROLEERC System develops uncrewed aircraft for certified operation, in a regulatory landscape that is still being written. This role is our presence in the standardisation bodies and industry associations where that landscape takes shape — EUROCAE, GAMA, UAVDACH and BDLI among them — in the working groups drafting the certification specifications, AMC, MOC and supporting standards our aircraft will be measured against. You bring our position into those rooms while the text is still open, and you bring back what it means for us. Inside the company you turn the evolving framework into the certification basis our programmes build against, take part in the exchange with the certification authorities, and support the airworthiness team on compliance work.

Since its foundation, Menlo Systems GmbH has been one of the world market leaders in the field of optical precision measurements with light and lasers. Based on the Nobel Prize-winning frequency comb technology, we provide our customers worldwide with laser systems that enable applications with the highest precision and accuracy. The systems are mainly used in metrology and spectroscopy, in optical clocks, in quantum technology and quantum computers, as well as in materials testing and 3D printing. Our customers include leading research institutions and high-tech companies worldwide.

To strengthen our team at our main location in Planegg-Martinsried near Munich, we are now looking for a

FPGA / Mixed-Signal Design Engineer (m/f/d)

Development of FPGA/SoC-based digital designs for the control and readout of complex, robust laser systems

Ownership of the full FPGA/SoC development lifecycle: from requirements definition and system architecture through RTL implementation, simulation and prototyping to a qualified product

Definition of the digital system architecture in close crossfunctional cooperation with other departments
Design and implementation of digital signal processing chains and control loops

Bring-up, verification and debugging of FPGA designs on target hardware, including measurements and performance analysis

Documentation of the design according to customer and quality requirements

Degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering or a comparable qualification

2+ years of experience in FPGA/digital design with Verilog/SystemVerilog and/or VHDL

Practical experience with AMD/Xilinx Vivado, Intel Quartus or comparable toolchains, including synthesis, place-and-route and static timing analysis

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Chapter Lead HR Data Platform and Reporting (f/m/d), you will lead a team of specialists responsible for Siemens Energy’s strategic central HR master data platform, HR Data Hub, data quality engineering capabilities, local German reporting, and the central HR reporting landscape. You will steer and drive the roadmaps for homegrown HR data and reporting applications that are critical for reliable master data, trusted workforce reporting, and data-driven HR decision-making. The role combines people leadership, deep IT and data platform understanding, application ownership, product roadmap management, stakeholder partnering, data governance, operational excellence, and transformation delivery across a complex global HR technology landscape.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Steer the strategy, roadmap, and operational ownership of the HR Data Hub, ensuring it serves as the central HR master data platform for Siemens Energy with reliable and standardized data products.
* Drive the HR realted global Reporting by providing consultancy to the Business stakeholders and Support the internal Team with feedback and Innovations.
* Lead the development of data quality engineering capabilities for HR master data, emphasizing rules, validation logic, monitoring concepts, and continuous improvement measures.
* Translate business data quality requirements into scalable technical designs and reusable engineering patterns across the HR Data Hub and related reporting applications.
* Partner with HR process owners and technical teams to enhance data completeness, accuracy, and consistency, while establishing transparent escalation and remediation processes for cross-system HR master data issues.
* Steer the modernization of local German HR reporting solutions and the central HR reporting landscape, ensuring reliable delivery for operational, management, and regulatory reporting needs.
* Provide strong technical leadership for homegrown HR data and reporting applications, ensuring secure and compliant operations in alignment with IT architecture and cybersecurity standards.

What You Bring

* University degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Informatics, or a comparable qualification.
* Longstanding experience in IT application management, data platform ownership, HR technology, reporting solutions, or digital product leadership.
* Proven experience managing business-critical, homegrown applications or data platforms in complex international environments.
* Strong experience with HR master data, data integration, data quality, reporting, analytics, or workforce reporting landscapes is highly desirable.
* Hands-on understanding of cloud-based data platforms, Snowflake or comparable data technologies, ETL/ELT concepts, APIs, data products, and modern software delivery practices is a strong advantage.
* Fluency in both German and English together with experience leading international teams, virtual organizations, or chapters in an agile, product-oriented, or platform engineering environment.
* Proven track record of stakeholder management, business partnering, roadmap steering, vendor governance, and transformation delivery at senior levels.

About the Team

Our Global Functions are essential in driving the company's strategic initiatives and ensuring operational excellence across various departments, business areas, and regions. These roles support our vision to become the most valued energy technology company in the world. As part of our team, you contribute to our vision by shaping the global energy transition, partnering with our internal and external stakeholders, and conducting business responsibly and in compliance with legal requirements and regulations.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.
